title: robotics.motion: circular, screw and spline paths of the tool, the arm configuration kept, the check of jumps in Trajectory
author: Claude-JG
description: exudyn.robotics.motion has the straight line as its only Cartesian path, which follows the nearest solution of the inverse kinematics and may change the arm configuration, and Trajectory does not notice a profile that starts with a jump. Decided (design sections 3 and 6.2): ProfileCartesianCircular (via point and end), ProfileCartesianScrew (axis, angle, translation) and ProfileCartesianSpline (via frames) on the common code of ProfileCartesianLinear; keepConfiguration (default True) keeps the arm configuration of the start and raises at a jump of the joint coordinates on the path; Trajectory(jumpTolerance) raises if a profile starts at other coordinates than the trajectory ends.
releaseNotes: exudyn.robotics.motion: ProfileCartesianCircular (the arc through a via point to the end), ProfileCartesianScrew (the tool frame turned about an axis and moved along it) and ProfileCartesianSpline (through via frames, positions and rotation vectors as natural cubic splines); with keepConfiguration=True (default) these and ProfileCartesianLinear keep the arm configuration of the start and raise a ValueError when the joint coordinates jump on the path; Trajectory(jumpTolerance) raises in Add if a profile starts at other coordinates than the trajectory ends.
